title: BACK↔SEC-001: mTLS/PKI Implementation + Device-Identity Conformance
description: Security provides the PKI/identity design, mTLS and authn/authz requirements, API-security requirements, and threat findings affecting the backend; Backend implements authn/authz (mTLS, OAuth/JWT, X.509 device-certificate handling) to the baseline and returns device-identity conformance evidence. Grounded in SECURITY_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.4. mTLS with X.509 device certificates is part of the mandatory security baseline.

mtls_required.description: mTLS is mandatory in the security baseline (always true).

mtls_implemented.description: Must be true to conform to the baseline.

evidence_artifacts.description: Test reports / scan results demonstrating conformance.

remediation_due_date.description: Required for CRITICAL/HIGH (CVSS-based SLA: Critical 7 days, High 30 days).

x-macp.tier_rationale: mTLS, X.509 device identity, and the PKI design are part of the mandatory security baseline; any weakening is a Tier-1 security-baseline change behind HG-01 (SEC release veto). ESC-SEC: agents may only propose; SEC owns binding decisions.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (baseline and PKI handoff at planning; authn/authz implementation reviews; pre-production security sign-off)
confirm_conditions: security_requirements carries a pki_design, mtls_required = true, and ≥1 authn_authz requirement
x509_device_cert_validation implemented per the PKI design
every CRITICAL/HIGH open_finding carries a remediation_due_date (Critical 7 days / High 30 days)
reject_conditions: mtls_implemented = false or device_identity_conformance ≠ CONFORMANT on a release path (baseline violation → ESC-SEC, HG-01)
a CRITICAL/HIGH finding without a remediation_due_date
any authn/authz weakening proposed without an ADR + SEC sign-off (never silently deviate)
counter_conditions: PARTIAL conformance with a credible remediation plan — request SEC risk-acceptance (SIRC) before sign-off, do not self-approve
X.509 rotation/lifecycle ambiguous — request the PKI lifecycle detail before implementation review
